parameters.name: AccessMode
parameters.description:
The network access mode. Valid values:

- **internet**: public network access.
- **vpc**: Express Connect private network access.

parameters.name: AccessRegion
parameters.description:
The Express Connect access region. Valid values:
- **cn-hangzhou**: Hangzhou.
- **cn-beiijng**: Beijing.
- **cn-shanghai**: Shanghai.

parameters.name: HttpPorts
parameters.description: The list of available ports for the HTTP protocol. The value is a string. If multiple ports are specified, they are returned in the format of **port1,port2,port3**.

parameters.name: HttpsPorts
parameters.description: The list of available ports for the HTTPS protocol. The value is a string. If multiple ports are specified, they are returned in the format of **port1,port2,port3**.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The WAF instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the current WAF instance ID.

parameters.name: LogFieldsNotReturned
parameters.description: The log fields to be returned.

parameters.name: ProtectionServerCount
parameters.description: The number of protection nodes that can be added to the cluster.

parameters.name: ProxyStatus
parameters.description:
The proxy gateway mode. Valid values:

- on: enabled.
- off: disabled.

parameters.name: ProxyType
parameters.description:
The cluster type. Valid values:
- **cname**: reverse proxy cluster.
- **service**: service-based cluster.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: RuleStatus
parameters.description:
The rule status. Valid values:
- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The rule type. Valid values:

bypass: bypasses security checks and directly allows the request.
